Naomi — quick technical note. I reviewed the redaction_scope_details.txt attached to Samir's request. We can proceed with the following: 

- Live systems: remove records from application logs (logstore keys), search index entries, and any analytics tables derived from those messages. Those operations are reversible-only by restoring from backup, so once deleted from live systems they won't appear in dashboards or internal search.
- Traces: we will identify and scrub matching trace IDs and remove associated KV cache snapshots tied to that conversation.
- Observability: we'll request a coordinated purge across the metrics pipeline so those events are omitted from aggregated charts (we'll mark the date range).

Limitations / legal dependencies:
- Immutable backups and cold storage: we do not have unilateral ability to expunge customer data from backups without an approved retention exception. That requires sign-off from Legal and Records Retention; Monica will lead.
- Audit trail: we will keep a minimal redaction audit record (who requested, when, what was removed) and include it in the removal report. That audit entry contains no copy of the removed content.

I will prepare an internal_removal_plan.md that lists the exact commands and keys. ETA after confirmation from Samir and Monica: 48-72 hours to complete live removals and produce the report.
